Author: AinaSnow
Name: XIVChatNext Server
Description:
Connect FFXIV to the XIVChat Next Windows client. Chat, friends, item/map cards and game screenshots, with optional self-hosted relay. English UI by default; Chinese is available in settings.

将 FFXIV 连接到 XIVChat Next 桌面客户端，支持聊天、好友、物品/地图卡片、游戏截图及可选自建中继。默认英文，可在设置中切换中文。
Punchline: Use chat away from the game.
Changelog:
Plugin 1.8.0 switches to encryption v2 (fresh keys per connection, replay protection; older clients fall back to v1 unless you turn it off), sends linkshell names for exports, and adds a switch to block screenshot requests. Desktop 1.6.0 adds a self-updating Windows installer, Markdown exports, and optional translation and AI summaries. Update both together.

插件 1.8.0 改用加密 v2（每次连接使用新密钥并防重放；旧客户端可回退到 v1，也可在设置中关闭），导出时附带通讯贝名称，并新增“允许客户端请求游戏截图”开关。客户端 1.6.0 新增可自动更新的安装包、Markdown 导出，以及可选的翻译和 AI 总结。请同时更新两者。
